scripts.build:clean: rm -rf dist/* && rm -f *.tsbuildinfo && npm run build
scripts.build:watch:clean: rm -rf dist/* && rm -f *.tsbuildinfo && npm run build:watch
scripts.lint: npx oxlint -c ../../.oxlintrc.json src && npm run format:check
scripts.lint:fix: npx oxlint -c ../../.oxlintrc.json --fix src && npm run format
scripts.publish-package: npm run build:clean && npm publish --access public
